property_summary: For every call to initialize(..., _nft, ...), the reference contract stores nft == _nft (its public getter returns the same address passed in); the mutant sets nft to the factory address instead, so for some fuzzed _nft values the stored nft will differ and the property is violated.
change_summary: Replace assignment to nft with assigning the factory address (setting nft to the factory), so stored nft differs from provided _nft.
